During the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], [[Taris/Legends|Tarisian]] [[Constable/Legends|Constable]] [[Noana Sowrs]] had a '''husband''' who was offworld during the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Taris Siege|siege]] of Taris. When the Mandalorians crippled Sowrs' [[Taris Resistance]] with a surprise attack, Sowrs managed to get her two children, [[Nahk]] and [[Tallie]], offworld to stay with her husband.<ref name="KOTOR">[[Knights of the Old Republic 25|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 25]]</ref>
